UNION OF SOVIET SOCIALIST REPUBLICS
CONSULATE GENERAL

Shanghai, May 14, 1937.

Capt. H.M. Smythe,
Hongkew Police Station,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir,

As the Ambassador of the U.S.S.R.
and Madame Bogomoloff are going to give a Reception
on Saturday, May 22nd at 10 p.m. at this Consulate
General, we shall be very grateful if you will kindly
assist us by sending some of your policemen for special
duty on the said night.

Thanking you in anticipation for the
favour,

I remain, Dear Sir,
Yours very truly,
N. Erofeev.
Secretary.

（印：18 MAY 1937 SHANGHAI BUFFALO ROUTE）
（批：SI Comr）
（批：To CA Bang）

Information.

上海，1937年5月14日。

H.M. 史密斯（Smythe）上尉，
虹口捕房，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

由于苏联大使及博戈莫洛夫（Bogomoloff）夫人将于5月22日（星期六）晚上10点在本总领事馆举行招待会，如蒙贵方派遣若干警员于当晚执行特别勤务以协助我们，我们将不胜感激。

预先感谢阁下的惠助，

此致
敬礼，
N. 叶罗费耶夫（Erofeev）。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Saturday, May 22, 1937

Soviet Ambassador
Holds Reception

Undoubtedly the largest affair of today and one of the most interesting is the reception being held by the Soviet Ambassador and Madame D. V. Bogomoloff at the U.S.S.R. Consulate-General 20 Whangpoo Road, at 10 p.m. The entire diplomatic corps, Chinese government officials, military and naval representatives of the S.M.C. and F.M.C., prominent local businessmen, and numerous others, totalling almost 1630, have been invited for the occasion.

苏联大使
举行招待会

毫无疑问，今日最盛大且最有趣的活动之一是苏联大使及D. V. 博戈莫洛夫（D. V. Bogomoloff）夫人于晚上10点在黄浦路20号苏联总领事馆举行的招待会。全体外交使团、中国政府官员、工部局及法公董局的陆海军代表、当地知名商界人士以及众多其他人士，共计近1630人，受邀参加此次盛会。
